channel.title: Impact Capital VC — AI Perspectives
channel.description: Analysis from Impact Capital VC on venture capital, the AI boom and the rise of agentic AI.

item.title: The Jensen Huang investigation: what it could mean for the AI industry
item.description: Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang after he admitted an affair. We assess the key-person, export-control and supply-chain implications for the AI industry.

item.title: The AI capital supercycle: where venture money is really flowing
item.description: AI now dominates venture capital. We map where the money goes — infrastructure, models and applications — and why the application layer is underpriced.

item.title: Why agentic AI is the next venture frontier
item.description: Chatbots answer questions; agents do work. Here is why agentic AI changes software economics and what investors should look for.

item.title: Beyond the foundation model: building moats in the application layer
item.description: If everyone can call the same model, where does defensibility come from? Data, workflow depth and distribution in unconventional niches.

item.title: Compute economics: how falling inference costs reshape AI startups
item.description: Inference keeps getting cheaper while frontier training gets more expensive. What this split means for startup margins and strategy.

item.title: From search to answers: GEO and AEO as a new venture category
item.description: As people ask AI assistants instead of searching, brands need generative and answer-engine optimisation. Why this is a new market.

item.title: Valuation discipline in the AI boom: lessons from past cycles
item.description: Every technology boom produces both lasting giants and expensive mistakes. How we stay disciplined while investing in AI.

item.title: Asia's AI corridor: why Singapore is a launchpad for agentic startups
item.description: Singapore combines research depth, regulatory clarity and access to diverse Asian markets — ideal conditions for agentic AI companies.

item.title: Scientist-founders: why researchers build the best agentic AI companies
item.description: Peer-reviewed research is becoming a commercial advantage. Why we look for founders who publish as well as ship.

item.title: Agentic AI for SMEs: automating cross-border growth
item.description: Small and mid-sized businesses could gain the most from AI agents. How agents can act as a marketing and export department.

item.title: Responsible AI as an investment criterion
item.description: Governance, transparency and privacy are not just compliance costs. Why we treat responsible AI as a source of long-term value.
